## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering outcome and the affected ownership
area.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the change.
- [ ] `vo-dev lint all` passes.
- [ ] Public behavior and compatibility documentation are updated.
- [ ] Security, performance, accessibility, and cross-target effects were
      considered where applicable.

## Evidence

List the commands run and any screenshots, benchmark reports, or generated
artifacts that help reviewers evaluate the change.
